summary: The root شتت primarily means to scatter, disperse, or separate things widely. It implies a state of disunity and fragmentation, often referring to people or affairs being broken up and spread apart.

headwords.gloss: Fore teeth; separate; wide-apart, one from another

parts.t: like white chamomiles of the sands:

headwords.def: شَتِيتٌ : see شَتٌّ , in four places. ثَغْرٌ شَتِيتٌ means [ Fore teeth ] separate, or wide-apart, one from another. (S, A, K.) Tarafeh says, مِنْ شَتِيتٍ كَأَقَاحِ الرَّمْلِ غُرْ [meaning From separate fore teeth like white chamomiles of the sands: ثَغْرٍ being understood, and غُرْ being for غُرٍّ ]. (TA.)
